newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-LIGHTNING STOPS PLAY IN B & H INTERNATIONAL.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-LIGHTNING STOPS PLAY IN B & H INTERNATIONAL.

text.p: Lightning and torrential rain caused play in the Benson and Hedges International to be held up for 45 minutes on Sunday.

Rain and high winds at the Oxfordshire Golf Club course have made playing conditions appalling for much of the tournament and at the start of the final round only 29 of the field of 68 had scores under par.
Overnight leader Bernhard Langer was due to tee off in mid-afternoon.
It was the second successive year that rain and high wind have blighted this tournament.
Colin Montgomerie, European number one for the past four years, found conditions particularly testing.
Starting at one over par, he dropped four strokes in the first two holes with a triple-bogey six on the par-three second, needing five attempts on the green before holing out.
Birdies on the next two holes were offset by bogeys at the following two. He completed the outward half in 41, five over.
